question.problem: A thin plate $D$ with the mass density function $\lambda (x,y)=\frac{x}{y}$ is enclosed between the lines $x=y$ and  $x=4-y$ for $1\le y\le 2.$ Find the moment of the plate about the $x$-axis.
question.worked_solution:
The moment of a lamina $D$ with the mass density function $\lambda (x,y)$ about the $x$-axis is given by

$$
{M}_{x}={∬}_{D}y\,\lambda (x,y)\,\text{d}A.
$$

In our case, $D$ is a type II plane region, as shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14121640/assets/1e0f4ff99aecd563d03f19f5d6a2ede10610ac7117048d2c0d229dbb9c05651c.png)

So, we have 

$$
D={(x,y)\,:\,y\le x\le 4-y,\,1\le y\le 2}
$$

and $\lambda (x,y)=\frac{x}{y}.$ 

Therefore, the moment is

$$
\begin{aligned}{M}_{x} & ={∬}_{D}y\cdot \frac{x}{y}\,\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{D}x\,\text{d}A \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{y}^{4-y}x\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}{[\frac{{x}^{2}}{2}]}_{x=y}^{x=4-y}\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}\frac{1}{2}[(4-y)^{2}-{y}^{2}]\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}\frac{1}{2}(16-8y+{y}^{2}-{y}^{2})\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}8-4y\,\text{d}y \\  & ={[8y-2{y}^{2}]}_{y=1}^{y=2} \\  & =(16-8)-(8-2) \\  & =2.\end{aligned}
$$
